title: 12 Best Pizza Places in Naples
description: Discover the 12 best pizza places in Naples, Italy. From historic pizzerias to modern interpretations, find your perfect Neapolitan pizza experience. Featuring real reviews and local tips.

places.name: L'Antica Pizzeria da Michele
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pizza Margherita (double mozzarella if you dare)

places.name: Gino Sorbillo Lievito Madre al Duomo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pizza Antica Margherita (with buffalo mozzarella) or try one of their seasonal specials.

places.name: 50 Kalò di Ciro Salvo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pizza Marinara (to truly appreciate the dough) or the classic Margherita. Their 'Pizza Fritta' is also exceptional.

places.name: Pizzeria Starita a Materdei
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pizza Montanara (fried pizza, then baked) or the classic Marinara. Don't forget their 'Angioletti' (fried dough bites with cherry tomatoes and arugula) for dessert.

places.name: Di Matteo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pizza Margherita and a 'Pizza Fritta' (fried pizza) or 'Frittatina di Pasta' (fried pasta omelet) for a true Neapolitan street food experience.

places.name: Concettina ai Tre Santi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Margherita D.O.C.' (with buffalo mozzarella) or one of their more creative, ingredient-focused pizzas like the 'Pizza al Ragu'.

places.name: Pizzeria Da Attilio
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pizza Carnivale (a star-shaped pizza with ricotta-filled points) or the 'Pizza con i Frutti di Mare' (seafood pizza).

places.name: Pizzeria Brandi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The original Pizza Margherita, of course, to taste history. Their pasta dishes are also very good.

places.name: Pizzeria La Notizia 94 (Enzo Coccia)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pizza Margherita (their classic is superb) or a special featuring seasonal, high-quality toppings. Their craft beer selection is also excellent.

places.name: Pizzeria Trianon da Ciro
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pizza Salsiccia e Friarielli (sausage and broccoli rabe) for a local favorite, or their classic Margherita.

places.name: Gorizia 1916
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pizza Diavola (spicy salami) or the classic Margherita, paired with a local wine.

places.name: Pizzeria Vesi (Via del Grande Archivio)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pizza Fiori di Zucca e Alici (zucchini flowers and anchovies, when in season) or a simple Margherita.
